title: SHOOTING THE SURVIVOR COSTS PLAYER 2 TOO
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. In co-op, a round from player 2 into the Survivor turned him only on player 2 own screen, which the host then put back, so THE SURVIVOR RETURNS FIRE repeated on every hit while the real Survivor kept walking to the ring and never fired. Killing him or the Peddler cost player 2 nothing, while the same kill by the host costs a notoriety point. Now a round from player 2 turns the Survivor on the host and he fires back at player 2, the line is said once, and a Survivor or Peddler that player 2 kills adds a notoriety point to his own save.
now: In co-op, the Survivor fires back at player 2 when shot, and killing him or the Peddler costs player 2 notoriety.
